en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the man who was seized and upon him were (several) Penalties, one of these being the killing.
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> used to establish upon him the (other) Penalties, then he<sup>asws</sup> would kill him, and Ali<sup>asws</sup> will not be opposed’.
